title: a struct on a cycle through a List is rejected as non-'Deinitable', depending on which structs have a __deinit__ of their own
compiler: rejects: "field 'children' has non-'Deinitable' type 'List[Node]'", as 1.2.0 did. With `def __deinit__(deinit self): pass` added to Node, it compiles and prints `0`

confirmation.notes: provisional ruling, until the human has discussed it with Modular

nightly.result: rejects with the same non-'Deinitable' error, as on 1.2.0, and so do the other suite programs; with the empty __deinit__ it prints `0`
